records.source: Special Items & Powers
records.translation: 特殊物品與能力

records.source: The old tree is gone... However, with 100 pieces of hardwood, this could be fixed up.
records.translation: 老樹不見了……不過，只要 100 份硬木就能修好這裡。

records.source: Use 100 pieces of hardwood to fix up the stump?
records.translation: 要使用 100 份硬木修好樹樁嗎？

records.source: Maybe someone will decide to move in...
records.translation: 也許會有人決定搬進來……

records.source: Um... There appears to be some kind of... anomalous reading... I... don't know what this means...
records.translation: 呃……似乎出現了某種……異常讀數……我……不知道這代表什麼……

records.source: The raccoon shop has been expanded.
records.translation: 浣熊商店擴建了。

records.source: Another player is talking to the Raccoon right now.
records.translation: 另一位玩家目前正在和浣熊交談。

records.source: Raccoon: Hungry... need fish...
records.translation: 浣熊：餓了……需要魚……

records.source: Raccoon: Now, maybe I find a wife...
records.translation: 浣熊：現在，也許我能找個妻子……

records.source: Raccoon: Hungry... need fruit...
records.translation: 浣熊：餓了……需要水果……

records.source: Raccoon: Now, we start a family...
records.translation: 浣熊：現在，我們要組成家庭……

records.source: Raccoon: Hungry... need mushroom...
records.translation: 浣熊：餓了……需要蘑菇……

records.source: Raccoon: Now we can grow the family bigger...
records.translation: 浣熊：現在我們能讓家庭變得更大……

records.source: Raccoon: Thirsty... need juice...
records.translation: 浣熊：渴了……需要果汁……

records.source: Raccoon: You're a good friend, bobo. Now we can have another...
records.translation: 浣熊：你是好朋友，寶寶。現在我們能再生一個……

records.source: Raccoon: Psst... bobo. I need a gift for the missus.
records.translation: 浣熊：噓……寶寶。我需要一份禮物送給太太。

records.source: Raccoon: We're happy for now, bobo...
records.translation: 浣熊：我們現在很幸福，寶寶……

records.source: Raccoon: Help us, and I'll give you something nice.
records.translation: 浣熊：幫助我們，我就給你一些好東西。

records.source: Raccoon: We're doing great, bobo...
records.translation: 浣熊：我們過得很好，寶寶……

records.source: Raccoon: Thanks, bobo. Take this...
records.translation: 浣熊：謝謝，寶寶。拿著這個……

records.source: It's a big tree, but the wood is starting to rot...
records.translation: 這是一棵大樹，但木頭已經開始腐爛……

records.source: There was a strong wind storm during the night...
records.translation: 夜裡颳起了一場強烈風暴……

records.source: You don't yet have the knowledge to use this...
records.translation: 你還沒有足夠的知識使用這個……

records.source: Mystery Boxes can now be found...
records.translation: 現在可以找到神祕盒了……

records.source: You sense that a new way is open...
records.translation: 你感覺到一條新道路開啟了……

records.source: Meadowlands Farm_It's not the best for growing crops, but there's a chewy blue grass that animals love. You start with two chickens.
records.translation: 草原農場_這裡不是最適合種植作物的地方，但有動物喜愛、嚼勁十足的藍草。開局時擁有兩隻雞。

records.source: {1} {0} frenzy has begun in town.
records.translation: 鎮上開始了{1}{0}魚群狂潮。

records.translation: 煤礦森林開始了{1}{0}魚群狂潮。

records.translation: 山區開始了{1}{0}魚群狂潮。

records.translation: 海灘開始了{1}{0}魚群狂潮。

records.source: Take the secret shortcut back?
records.translation: 要走祕密捷徑回去嗎？

records.source: I'm going to the festival today, kid! You'll have to drive yourself.       -Pam
records.translation: 孩子，我今天要去參加節慶！你得自己開車。       ——潘姆

records.source: Closed until noon.
records.translation: 中午前暫停營業。

records.source: Ahh... nothing like the warm air of Calico Desert. The pig loves it, too.
records.translation: 啊……沒有什麼比卡利科沙漠的暖空氣更舒服了。豬也很喜歡。

records.source: Coming to bed?
records.translation: 要來睡覺了嗎？

records.source: Goodnight, {0}.
Instant
records.translation: 立即

records.source: My dear {0},^^If you're reading this note, you've found the secret room I've prepared for you.^^Within these walls are tips, recipes, and even some of my most cherished tools... all the very best from the many happy years I spent in the valley.^^By coming this far, you'll have proven that you possess the skill and wisdom to make good use of these powerful secrets.^^I hope my discoveries help you in your journey to making {1} Farm a shining star of the whole world!^^Make me proud!^-Grandpa
records.translation: 親愛的{0}：^^如果你讀到這張紙條，就表示找到了我為你準備的祕密房間。^^這些牆壁之內有訣竅、食譜，甚至還有幾件我最珍愛的工具……全都是我在山谷度過多年幸福時光所留下的精華。^^能走到這一步，就證明你擁有足以善用這些強大祕密的技巧與智慧。^^希望我的發現能在旅途中幫助你，讓{1}農場成為全世界閃耀的明星！^^讓我為你驕傲！^——爺爺

records.source: You feel Grandpa's hand patting your shoulder...
records.translation: 你感覺到爺爺的手輕拍著肩膀……

records.source: Mr. Qi: Oh, you thought you could obtain my precious fruit whenever you like? Pshh... Only during the challenge, kid.
records.translation: 齊先生：噢，你以為隨時都能取得我珍貴的果實嗎？嘖……只有挑戰期間才行，孩子。

records.source: I'm on vacation today! You'll have to drive yourself.       -Pam
records.translation: 我今天休假！你得自己開車。       ——潘姆

records.source: Grants one (1) lifetime subscription to the Official Joja THRIVE Collection, featuring 40 exclusive furniture pieces!
records.translation: 提供一（1）份 Joja 官方 THRIVE 系列終身訂閱，內含 40 件獨家家具！

records.source: Waterfall Farm_Grandpa left you a magic lamp that grants a powerful bonus. However, you've also inherited his 1,000,000g debt to JojaBank, and must pay it off in seasonal installments...
records.translation: 瀑布農場_爺爺留給你一盞能提供強大加成的魔法燈。不過，你也繼承了他欠 Joja 銀行的 1,000,000g 債務，必須每季分期償還……

records.source: ???: Very touching... Now, just sign the paper here...
records.translation: ？？？：非常感人……現在，只要在這份文件上簽名……

records.source: NOTICE:^^At the end of the season, {0}g will be debited from your account.^^Failure to pay will result in a negative balance.^^Thank you for your patronage.^-JojaBank
records.translation: 通知：^^季末將從你的帳戶扣除 {0}g。^^若無法付款，帳戶餘額將變為負數。^^感謝你的惠顧。^——Joja 銀行
